subject.title: refactor(speech-core): share TTS request pre-resolution across discord and voice-call

question: Should TTS request pre-resolution become a supported callable on the plugin runtime API?
rationale: The patch adds a new `PluginRuntime.tts` callable, and repository policy requires explicit maintainer direction for a permanent plugin API addition even when it is additive and well tested.

options.title: Approve runtime API
options.body: Keep the callable on `api.runtime.tts`, establish its compatibility intent, and validate both migrated consumers with real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Use a bundled internal speech-core bridge instead if maintainers do not want external plugins to depend on request pre-resolution.

options.title: Pause consolidation
options.body: Hold this phase until the durable TTS preparation ownership boundary is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve runtime API
recommendation.body: Keep the callable on `api.runtime.tts`, establish its compatibility intent, and validate both migrated consumers with real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history identifies this person as the recent contributor driving the voice-stack consolidation and the best routing candidate for this boundary decision.
